description: How do households in these countries split their budget, and how much inflation do food and energy add?. For 1-5 countries: household budget shares by COICOP group (OECD national accounts), latest food / energy / headline CPI inflation (World Bank) and the percentage-point contribution of food and household energy given each country's budget weights. Computed by Lilambd. Routes: /answer (countries*); /countries (limit). Paid $0.5 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.
